requirements.text: Students should be able to view their checked-out items, due dates, and any outstanding fines online.
The system must allow students to borrow, return, and renew items online without requiring a visit to the desk.
Booking study rooms should be straightforward, with an easy way to check availability and select times.
Fines should be calculated based on overdue days, with clear communication about rates and notifications for students regarding due dates and fines.
Librarians need tools to manage inventory, generate usage reports, and place holds on student accounts for outstanding fines, with a clear process to prevent oversight.
